maker: Kobelco ROBOTiX Co., Ltd. (Kobe Steel group)
name: Kobelco ROBOTiX Ishimatsu portable welding robot
summary: Small portable rail-guided welding robot from Kobe Steel's welding robot company, used for building steel (columns and joints), shipbuilding, construction machinery and bridges; it holds the Japanese type certification for building steel welding.

germany.statusNote: Sold in Japan by Kobelco ROBOTiX; no German or EU sales page, distributor or CE information found.

specs.label: Fields of use
specs.value: building steel, shipbuilding, construction machinery, bridges
specs.quote: 建築・造船・建機・橋梁などの分野で

specs.label: Certification
specs.value: Japanese type certification for building steel welding (建築鉄骨溶接型式認証)
specs.conditions: stated for the cableless version, which applies the Ishimatsu certification
specs.quote: 石松™　が取得している建築鉄骨溶接型式認証を適用

specs.label: Wireless teaching box range
specs.quote: 通信距離３０ｍと広い範囲をカバー

specs.label: Wireless teaching box runtime
specs.conditions: cableless version, full charge; 4 h charging
specs.quote: 最大８時間の連続使用が可能（フル充電時）

notes: Portable welding robot on a guide rail that is set on the workpiece; one operator can run several units (maker PDF).
Series can be extended with rotating positioners into welding systems (maker page).
